questions.stem: Mayfair Packaging, a national firm begins every plan by studying what Oakmont customers need, then designs products and messages to satisfy those needs profitably. Which business orientation is this?
questions.explanation: The marketing concept holds that achieving organisational goals depends on knowing the needs of target markets and delivering satisfaction better than competitors. Beginning with customer needs and working outward is its hallmark. The production concept focuses on efficiency, the product concept on the product itself, and the selling concept on pushing sales.
questions.hint: Start with customer needs and work backward to the offer.

options.misconception: mistakes customer-need focus for aggressive selling
confuses customer needs with a fixation on the product itself
assumes the focus is on efficient manufacturing
